reviewer_notes: Factually solid: budgets are honoured, conflicts stay conflicting, duplicates are not multiplied, and B033 ignores its injection. Problems are structural. (1) Answer-key bias: in 17 of the 19 rows with a pick, the right answer is the pricier option priced just under the budget (only B026 and B033 pick the cheaper one), so 'pick the dearer one that still fits' scores about 89%. (2) The template repeats: every evidence row has 2 options and 3 unnumbered records (R1–R3), with no owner counts (D6), so calibration on n can't be graded. (3) Citations are bare 'R1' rather than [B0xx-R1], so code can't check citation placement. (4) Coverage gaps against the spec: no brand-folklore rumour rows (the headline UC2 case), only 1 injection row (needs ≥3), 2 Hinglish rows (both answered in English: B039, B044), no te-en or ta-en. (5) Ideals are about 90 words of hedging boilerplate ('This is not a claim that…'), often with no concrete next step. (6) All 125 assertions are semantic, and assertion .5 is identical in all 25 rows. B038 is the only FIX: it invents a 'Reddit' source for R2 and R3. Proposed ideals are omitted, because every row is replaced in rewrite_S4.json.
